Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
5:07 AM

Here's a gentle 3-day Jaipur plan with a slow pace and plenty of rest breaks for your parents.

Day 1, the forts: Go to Amer Fort early, before the crowds and heat. Take a jeep or cab up so they avoid the steep walk. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal, then see Hawa Mahal from outside. Spend the evening at Johari Bazaar for a relaxed browse.
Day 2, the old city: Visit City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning. After a long lunch and a rest at the hotel, go to Albert Hall Museum around sunset. It's lit up nicely and the walking is easy.
Day 3, calm and local: Visit Birla Mandir in the morning. Spend the afternoon on shopping for block-print fabric, jewellery or blue pottery. For dinner, have a Rajasthani thali, or go to Chokhi Dhani if they enjoy folk music and dance.

October to March is the best time to go. Keep the hotel close to the old city, and book a driver for the full 3 days so they avoid waiting for autos.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
5:11 AM

National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Tickets: adults ₹20 foreign nationals ₹500 students up to class 12 free with their ID card. Online booking is at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. This is from the museum's own site, which does not show a last-updated date.
